Longevity Life Academy is delighted to invite you to The Longevity Masterclass Event of the Year.

Tonight, Tuesday, October 27, at 7:00 PM ET, live on Zoom.
Reserve your seat: https://www.longevitylifeacademy.com/julie-masterclass
Can't make it tonight? Second live session: Saturday, November 14, at 1:00 PM ET.

Julie Gibson Clark is the second slowest aging person ever measured. Epigenetic testing shows she ages 6.5 years per decade. She is 56, a single mom and a recruiter from Phoenix, with no lab, no doctors and no millions behind her. For one hour, live, she reveals the real protocol that got her there.

What Julie teaches:
• How her pace of aging is measured, and what the number means
• The foundations that do the real work: sleep, food, movement and stress
• Her full day, 5:00 am to 9:00 pm, built to repeat
• Why she tests before she buys any supplement

The masterclass starts at $49 for the full 60-minute live session. VIP access adds a private 30-minute Q&A with Julie.

Live seats are limited. 14-day full refund.
Reserve your seat: https://www.longevitylifeacademy.com/julie-masterclass
